<!-- Write the title and body in English. Follow https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/blob/dev/docs/development-flow.md and target dev by default. -->

## Summary

Explain the source problem and the focused changes that address it.

## Outcome

Describe the resulting behavior, including a before/after example when useful. State any intentionally incomplete Issue scope; claim to close an Issue only when its implementation is complete.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and their results. Report failures, skipped checks, and unperformed checks with reasons. Choose checks appropriate to the changed files and available repository tooling; documentation-only changes need Markdown/template syntax, link, whitespace, and consistency checks, without unrelated runtime or device testing.

## Related Issues

Link the source Issue and any related Issues. Use `Closes #<number>` only when the PR fully addresses the Issue.

## Required post-merge verification

None, unless the source Issue requires checks possible only after merge. List those checks separately as pending until performed; pre-merge validation does not prove deployment or publication succeeded.
